description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements a logging mechanism for Android applications by wrapping around the native android.util.Log utility. It provides methods for forwarding log messages to subsequent log nodes and handles message formatting and exception logging.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility to allow logging messages and chaining log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which logging data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, and forwards the message to the next node if set.
